<fidel-lesson-map>

Where am I, and jump anywhere. A lesson navigation with jump links to the parts on the page, chapter buttons, and "You have watched 40%".

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Blind learners who move by headings and landmarks, and everyone in a long lesson.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-lesson-map>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
forid of a <fidel-player>the first player with an idThe lesson's player.
chaptersURL (WebVTT)the player's chapters / chapters-amChapters for the "Play from" buttons.
notes-ididnotesId of the notes part.
code-ididcodeId of the code part.
next-href, next-labelURL, textfrom a <fidel-step-nav> on the pageThe next lesson.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-lesson-map>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-lesson-map-play{ seconds }A chapter button was used.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • A <nav aria-label="This lesson"> with real links and buttons.
  • Links appear only for parts that exist on the page: Video, Transcript, Notes, Code, Next lesson.
  • Progress is never announced by itself; "Where am I?" says it on request.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks: Jump links to each part of the lesson.
  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: A real <nav>, <ul> and <progress>.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: The "Where am I?" answer goes through a polite live region.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
